task.title: To insert fields in a template as a table

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce) and open the template.
In the Templates pane, go to Work> F ields
Place the cursor in the section of the template text where you want to insert a table and click Insert New Fields. This opens the Insert Fields dialog box.
Select an Object (i.e., "Agreement") from the left column. To search a field related to the selected object in the right column, enter a keyword and click the Search icon () or press enter.
Select the required fields. On Mac: hold command and select one or more fields from the list. On Windows: hold Ctrl (keyboard key) and select the fields.

note.p: Fields are inserted as columns in the table based on the order you select. Do not move your cursor when the fields are being inserted.

step.cmd: Select the checkbox Insert as a table.

postreq.p: A Repeat Table is inserted into your template with each field displayed as a separate column.
